taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station H-05, survey area H. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 26.6 | 4.30 | 4.30
2 | 119.1 | 2.37 | 6.67
3 | 340.4 | 0.77 | 7.44
4 | 640.3 | 0.77 | 8.21
5 | 2441.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station H-05, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station H-05 (Area H)**

**Interpreted Layer Sequence:**
* Layer 1 (0.00–4.30 m): 26.6 Ω·m
* Layer 2 (4.30–6.67 m): 119.1 Ω·m
* Layer 3 (6.67–7.44 m): 340.4 Ω·m
* Layer 4 (7.44–8.21 m): 640.3 Ω·m
* Layer 5 (>8.21 m): 2441.4 Ω·m (basement)

**Curve Type Evaluation:**
Resistivity increases monotonically across all layers ($r_1 < r_2 < r_3 < r_4 < r_5$). For a 5-layer model ($N=5$), evaluating triplets 1-2-3, 2-3-4, and 3-4-5 yields three 'A' transitions, producing an **AAA-type** (or single-letter **A-type**) curve. The recorded **AA-type** classification is flagged as an error, as it applies to a 4-layer system rather than the 5 layers modeled.

{"curve_type_stated": "AA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
